title: Boing Voyage

prompt: Boing Voyage (Platformer). You play as a springy rubber ball named Pip bouncing through a hand-painted world, inspired by the satisfying ball-bouncing games on portal sites but entirely original. The ball always bounces automatically on landing; the player steers left/right (A/D, arrows, or on-screen touch halves) and can hold to "squish" for a charged super-bounce or tap down for a fast ground-pound that slams through cracked blocks. Physics must feel springy and weighty: real momentum, air control with inertia, visible squash-and-stretch on every impact, wobble on wall-bounces, and a camera that eases and leads. The world is full of bounce toys: spring pads, angled bumpers that ricochet you, conveyor walls, jelly blocks that absorb, sticky honey, wind fans, cannons that fire you, portals, crumbling platforms, spikes and rolling enemies you can stomp. Chaining bounces without touching the ground builds a combo multiplier with escalating pitch and particle bursts; wall-bounce chains and stomp chains score extra. Each level has stars/gems to collect, three hidden golden bolts, and a finish flag with a 3-star rating for time, gems and no-hit. Make at least 5 worlds (e.g. Toybox Meadow, Candy Caverns, Clockwork Factory, Frosty Peaks, Storm Sky) of 8 levels each plus a boss level per world where you bounce on the boss's weak spots, every world introducing two new mechanics. Collected gems buy unlockable ball skins (12+, each with its own bounce sound and trail: beach ball, bowling ball that bounces lower, golf ball, slime, disco, planet, etc.) on a skin shelf. Add a world map with animated path, achievements (20+), and a daily "Bounce Gauntlet" endless mode with a best score. Art: soft painterly 2D with layered parallax, warm lighting, cute wiggly eyes on Pip that react to speed, fear and joy. Save world/level progress, stars, gems, skins, settings and best scores under gamebop.boing-voyage.
